info.name: Mastercard Bill Payment Validator Account Opening Scans API
Retrieve an outcome for an authentication.

items.docs:
Authenticate user identity and retrieve identity attributes without updating selfie.   
**This API is mandatory.**

info.name: Returns the status of the document verification.

params.name: scan_id
params.description: UUID returned to the application/webpage on completion of the users interactions with the ID-V SDK.

params.name: user_consent
params.description: The value which best reflects the input of the User with regard to Consent to use their data (ACCEPT, DECLINE, REVOKE, EXPIRE).

params.name: retrieve_selfie
params.description: Flag indicating if the selfie needs to be retrieved.

params.name: retrieve_document_images
params.description: Flag indicating if the document images needs to be retrieved.

params.name: retrieve_facemap
params.description: Flag indicating if the facemap needs to be retrieved.

params.name: document_type
params.description: The type of document scanned (DRIVING_LICENSE, PASSPORT, ID_CARD).

params.name: user_selected_country
params.description: The ISO 3166-1 alpha3 code which corresponds to the country from where the request to ID is originating from.

items.docs: Returns the status of the document verification as it's being processed by the vendor.
